market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is one of many potential Republican candidates for 2028, but at this early stage (4+ years out) no single candidate justifies a 14% implied probability. The 2024 election outcome (incumbency) will heavily shape the 2028 field, and even in an open primary, figures like DeSantis, Haley, or a fresh face are equally or more likely to emerge. The current price is dramatically above any reasonable baseline for a non-frontrunner this far from the election.
evidence_points: Election is 4+ years away, with immense uncertainty about candidates and political climate.
Rubio placed a distant third in the 2016 Republican primaries and did not run in 2024.
Prediction markets for years-ahead elections typically price individual longshots at 1–5%, not double digits.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of US politics and 2016/2024 primary fields
Historical betting odds for early-cycle presidential markets
Political analysis of 2028 GOP prospective candidates
